title: Quick Snap — Event & VPS
description: Guest activity, upload health, app latency and VPS status. Provisioned from the repo; UI edits are overwritten on restart.

panels.title: Photos stored
panels.description: Authoritative count read from the database, not a counter — survives restarts.

panels.title: Guests joined
panels.description: Distinct rolls across all events. One roll per phone number per event.

panels.title: Photos / min
panels.description: Live capture rate. This is the pulse of the event.

panels.title: Open events
panels.description: Active, started, not yet ended.

panels.title: Upload success
panels.description: Accepted photos as a share of real attempts. Normal gating (finished rolls, closed window) is counted in quicksnap_capture_gated_total and deliberately excluded here.

panels.title: Capture rate
panels.description: Single series, so the title names it and the legend is suppressed.

panels.title: Capture failures by reason
panels.description: Genuine failures only — anything here is worth investigating. Expected refusals (roll finished, event closed) are in the panel beside this.

panels.title: Expected refusals (normal)
panels.description: Rolls finishing and time-window gating. Healthy activity — roll_full rising late in an event is guests using their last frames.

panels.title: Upload size distribution
panels.description: Where photo sizes actually land. Drives the ETA the guest sees.

panels.title: Capture latency
panels.description: Percentiles of one measure, so they share a single hue as an ordinal ramp rather than reading as three unrelated series.

panels.title: Request rate by view
panels.description: Views are a fixed set from the URLconf; unrouted requests collapse into <unmatched>.

panels.title: p95 latency by view
panels.description: Capture carries a multi-MB JPEG, so it sits far above the page renders.

panels.title: Responses by status class
panels.description: Status colours are reserved for state and never reused as series hues.

panels.title: Join outcomes
panels.description: 'resumed' means a guest re-entered their number and picked their roll back up. 'throttled' means the failed-join limit kicked in.

panels.title: Storage growth
panels.description: Both in bytes, so they share one axis honestly. Photos are what grows.

panels.title: CPU utilisation
panels.description: All cores averaged. Dashed lines mark 75% and 90%.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: 'total' is drawn as context, not a competing series.

panels.title: Disk used
panels.description: Running the VPS out of disk mid-event loses photos. Watch this one.

panels.title: Load average
panels.description: One measure over three windows: an ordinal ramp of a single hue.

panels.title: Network throughput
panels.description: Virtual and container interfaces excluded so this is real WAN traffic.

panels.title: Disk I/O
panels.description: Photo uploads land here as writes.

panels.title: CPU by container
panels.description: This VPS is shared. When the box is busy, this says which service is responsible.

panels.title: Memory by container
panels.description: Working set — the memory actually resident, not just reserved.

options.content:
**Provisioned dashboard.** Edit `deploy/monitoring/grafana/dashboards/quicksnap.json` in the repo — UI edits here are overwritten when Grafana restarts.

- **App metrics** come from `GET /metrics` on the Django app (`snap/metrics.py`). That endpoint is token-gated and blocked at nginx.
- **Counters reset** when the app redeploys; the `quicksnap_photos` / `quicksnap_guests` gauges are read live from the database and do not.
- **Prometheus UI** is private: `ssh -L 9090:localhost:9090 german-vps`, then <http://localhost:9090>.
